text: Accuracy is defined as the ratio of correct predictions to total predictions.
Precision measures the proportion of true positive predictions among all positive predictions made.
Recall (Sensitivity) measures the proportion of true positives correctly identified among all actual positives.
F1-score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall.

Specificity measures the true negative rate (TN / (TN + FP)).
ROC curve plots True Positive Rate (Sensitivity) against False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity).
